setting.autoSplit: Automatically arrange source above waveforms when opening a waveform or navigating to source. The manual split command is always available.
setting.cacheSizeMB: Decoded waveform event cache budget in MiB per waveform backend. Zero disables retention. Apply live from Wave Workbench's cache page.
setting.psfxlMemoryCacheSizeMB: SHM PSFXL raw sample RAM cache budget in MiB per waveform backend. Zero disables retention. Apply live from Wave Workbench's cache page.
setting.psfxlCacheSizeMB: SHM PSFXL sample cache budget on disk in MiB per waveform backend. Zero disables retention. Apply live from Wave Workbench's cache page.
setting.mcpEnabled: Enable the same-user local Wave Workbench MCP bridge. Reload the VS Code window after changing this setting.
